ADVERTISEMENT FOR RESEARCH ASSISTANT POSITION 
 
Department of Architecture and Planning 
Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal 
 
Walk in Interview 
Eligible and motivated candidates are called for a Walk in Interview for the below mentioned position in 
Indian Council of Social Science Research (ICSSR), New Delhi & National Science and Technology Council 
(NSTC), Taipei, Taiwan sponsored research project titled "Cross-National Assessment of Green Finance 
Instruments for Net-Zero Transitions: A Comparative Study of Taiwan and India" in the Department of Architecture and Planning, MANIT Bhopal. 
 
1. Position Details: 
 Position: Research Assistant 
 Number of Posts: 01(One) 
 Duration: 12 (Eleven) months 
 Fellowship/Remuneration: ₹37,000/- per month 
 
2. Essential Qualifications: 
 Postgraduate Degree in Economics, Finance or Energy Studies (55% minimum), with focus on Energy Economics / Energy Finance with NET / GATE / SLET / M.Phil. / Ph.D.  
 Proficiency in research report writing, data analysis, and academic communication. 
 Familiarity with qualitative and/or quantitative research methods. 
 Candidate having published in high quality journals shall be preferred. 
 Working knowledge of Statistical tools like SPSS, R, etc. will be an added advantage. 
 
Application Procedure: 
Interested candidates are required to appear for an interview on the 23rd November 2026 at 10:00 AM in the Committee Room, Architecture and Planning Department, MANIT, Bhopal along with following documents: 
 
1. Properly filled Application Form 
2. Detailed CV. 
3. Copies of degree certificates and mark sheets. 
4. Statement of purpose (max. 500 words) explaining your suitability for the post. 
5. Title Page of the SCI/ESCI/SCIE/Scopus Indexed publications, if any 
6. Any other relevant documents (experience certificates, publication, etc.).  
 
Date of Interview: 23rd November 2026 
 
Note: 
 The position is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. 
 No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview. 
 The institute reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason. 
 
 
Address for Communication:  Dr. Rahul Tiwari  Principal Investigator-ICSSR NSTC Research Project 
Department of Architecture and Planning 
Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology (MANIT), Bhopal - 462003 Email: rahultiwari@manit.ac.in

Exams » DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 The Delhi Subordinate Services Selection Board (DSSSB) has released the DSSSB Recruitment 2026 notification under Advertisement No. 06/2026 for 1,075 Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) vacancies across various Delhi government departments. The vacancies include General Duty, MTS Aaya (Female) and other MTS posts. The online application process will start on 12 November 2026 and continue until 11 December 2026. DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026: Overview The DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 offers 1,075 vacancies for candidates who have passed Class 10 or hold an equivalent qualification. The selection will be based on a One-Tier General Examination, followed by the required document scrutiny. Candidates can check the important recruitment details below. Particulars Details Organisation DSSSB Advertisement No. 06/2026 Post Name Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) Total Vacancies 1,075 Post Code 810/26 Application Mode Online Application Start Date 12 November 2026 Last Date to Apply 11 December 2026 Qualification 10th Pass Age Limit 18–27 years (post-wise conditions apply) Pay Level Level 1 Salary ₹18,000–₹56,900 Official Website dsssb.delhi.gov.in DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF DSSSB has published Advertisement No. 06/2026 dated 6 November 2026 for MTS and other posts under the Combined Examinations 2026. The notification contains details about department-wise vacancies, educational qualifications, age limits, reservation, examination scheme, application fee and selection procedure. Candidates should read the detailed advertisement carefully before submitting their applications to check the requirements for their preferred post and department. DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026 Notification PDF DSSSB MTS Vacancy 2026: Department-Wise The board has announced 1,075 MTS vacancies across nine departments and offices of the Delhi Government. The Directorate of Education has the highest number of posts, with 757 MTS General Duty vacancies and 239 MTS Aaya (Female) vacancies. The department-wise vacancy distribution is given below. Eligible candidates can apply through the DSSSB Online Application Registration System (OARS). The last date to submit the application form and complete the required payment is 11 December 2026 . Candidates should keep their registration details, photograph, signature and relevant certificates ready before starting the application process. Women candidates and applicants belonging to SC, ST, PwBD and Ex-Servicemen categories are exempted from paying the fee, subject to the conditions mentioned in the notification. Category Application fee(Rs.) General / OBC / EWS ₹100 SC / ST / PwBD / Ex-servicemen Exempted Mode of Payment SBI e-Pay Online How to Apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026? Candidates can complete the DSSSB MTS application process online through the official OARS portal. Follow these steps to submit the application form: Visit the official DSSSB website at dsssb.delhi.gov.in. Open the online application portal through the recruitment link. Complete the registration process using the required details. Log in with the registered credentials. Select the relevant MTS recruitment application under Advertisement No. 06/2026 and Post Code 810/26. Enter personal, educational and other required information. Upload the photograph, signature and necessary documents in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee, if applicable. Review the application form and submit it. Download or print the submitted application form for future reference. DSSSB MTS Eligibility Criteria 2026 Candidates must fulfil the prescribed educational qualification and age requirements to apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026. The eligibility conditions are determined with reference to the closing date of the application process, i.e. 11 December 2026. Post-specific requirements should also be checked in the official advertisement. Educational Qualification Candidates must have passed Matriculation (Class 10) or an equivalent examination from a recognised board or institution. Certain departments may also accept an ITI qualification as specified in their respective post requirements. For MTS Aaya (Female), only eligible female candidates can apply. Age Limit The general age limit for DSSSB MTS posts is 18 to 27 years as on 11 December 2026. The prescribed age relaxation will be provided to eligible reserved-category candidates as per government rules. The paper will contain 200 objective-type questions carrying 200 marks, with a total duration of two hours. DSSSB MTS Salary 2026 Candidates selected for Multi-Tasking Staff posts will receive a salary under Pay Level 1 of the 7th Central Pay Commission. The basic pay starts at ₹18,000 per month and can increase up to ₹56,900, along with applicable allowances under Delhi Government rules. DSSSB MTS Salary Structure Pay Level Basic Pay Pay Scale Level-1 ₹18,000 ₹18,000 – ₹56,900 Allowances Included Dearness Allowance (DA) House Rent Allowance (HRA) Transport Allowance (TA) Medical Benefits Pension under the New Pension Scheme (NPS) The gross monthly salary of a DSSSB MTS employee ranges between ₹22,000 and ₹25,000 (approx.) , depending on posting location and applicable allowances. A total of 1,075 Multi-Tasking Staff vacancies have been announced under Advertisement No. 06/2026. Q2. When will the DSSSB MTS application process begin? The online application process will begin on 12 November 2026 at 12:00 noon. Q3. What is the last date to apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026? The last date to submit the online application is 11 December 2026 (11:59 PM). Q4. What is the educational qualification required for DSSSB MTS posts? Candidates generally need to have passed Class 10 or an equivalent examination from a recognised board. Certain departments may have additional or alternative qualification requirements. Q5. What is the age limit for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026? The general age limit is 18 to 27 years as on 11 December 2026, with applicable relaxations for eligible categories. Q6. What is the selection process for DSSSB MTS 2026? Selection will be based on a One-Tier General Examination, followed by e-dossier submission and document scrutiny. Q7. What is the salary of DSSSB MTS employees? The MTS posts fall under Pay Level 1, with a pay scale of ₹18,000 to ₹56,900. Q8. Where can candidates apply for DSSSB MTS Recruitment 2026? Candidates can submit their applications through the official online portal at https://dsssbonline.nic.in/.
